Backports [#31554](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/pull/31554) and [#31555](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/pull/31555).

- Builtin API allowlists use the root module's declared repository name and the module defining the callback. Other aliases of the main repository do not grant builtin access.
- External packages and `.bzl` files no longer depend on the main repository mapping unless they need it to print a label. Unaffected external packages can therefore remain cached after the root module's dependencies change.
- Package loading also restarts correctly if a deferred finalizer needs the main repository mapping while printing a label.
